# the contributor audit: cyclic support-volume and aligned-triangle critical branch

Read `candidate cce182d75ffe5c52`.
PASS after requesting an explicit coordinate-translation sign clarification.

R has determinant1, cycles the three normals and preserves T. The
Minkowski average remains in T, has equal opposite supports S/3, and
has area at least b. The three exact branches of |T intersect(-mT)|
are correct, including the transition values1/2 and2. The Cauchy--Schwarz
optimization gives3sqrt(7)-6, with an actual symmetric hexagon attaining
it. Positivity of S follows by evaluating each support at an interior
point, so no missing m=0 case is used.

For the aligned triangle, coordinates X=x+t1,Y=y+t2 give its area
(t1+t2+t3)^2/2. Properness of every A cut supplies h_A(-v_i)>1.
Actual midpoint support inequalities then give2sum(t_i)>3+S. The
ratio lower bound reduces exactly to (m+1)^2/[4f(m)]>=3/2; in the
middle branch the numerator difference is3(m-1)^2. The strictness
comes from the proper cuts. The stated example attains3/2 as an
infimum and is claimed only for geometry, not for critical caps.

The global-depth corollary correctly compares Q to the ordinary
centroid of K, an actual point in its fiber. The two positive-part
profiles imply Q<=4b/9+w/3 under a hypothetical bad target; w<=Q
then gives Q<=2b/3, contradicting Q>=4k/9 with k>3b/2. A condition
that B be nonheavy is NOT needed in this argument.

The optional equalization varies the genuine integer tilt while
leaving the own cap fixed. Captured endpoint volumes are continuous,
cross from unequal extremes to equal positive t,t, and global cap
minimality gives2t>=w. Actual midpoint BM givesq>=t, so w<=2Q/3.
Thus Q<=4b/7 and k<=9b/7 are valid bad-regime necessities.

The circumscribed triangle Kbar contains K and inherits the midpoint
inclusion. Applying the geometric theorem to Kbar and dividing the
last k bound yields k/|Kbar|<6/7, with the stronger m-dependent
expression as stated. This is an actual area deficit, not a claimed
approximation theorem. No general contradiction for that deficit is
proved. All geometry is in the continuous plane; the lattice and
ambient closed halfspace family remain unchanged.
